answer.evidence: Single root cause dirty B-ODF connector after 23-Oct patching. A-TX normal, link A-ODF to B-ODF shows ~2.8dB excess vs commissioning, B-ODF to B-RX matches 7dB attenuator design, embedded OTDR both ends shows ~2.9dB reflective loss at B-ODF with degraded reflectance, and scope image shows contamination spots near core. SC-01 bidirectional asymmetry is normal G.652/G.655 mismatch, not a fault.
